name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.28-beta “Paris” (build 33) — LibreOffice Writer add-in, storage settings, Windows 10.
• New: LibreOffice Writer add-in (Settings → Add-ins): a LitArbi toolbar and menu in Writer to cite exhibits, insert the List of Exhibits, set the citation format and toggle bold — same exhibit file and numbering as the Word add-in.
• Settings → Storage now offers the same providers as the Mac (Local, own server, Nextcloud/WebDAV, SharePoint, Azure Blob, Amazon S3); passwords and keys are kept in the Windows Credential Manager.
• Windows 10: every icon now has a Windows 10 equivalent; dark title bars also on older Windows 10 versions.
• Builds 31–32: Windows 11 design, native ARM64, Windows 11 dialogs and About.
